blocks.text: SUBIC, Zambales — A marbled water monitor lizard, locally known as “bayawak,” was rescued here and brought to a wildlife rescue center for assessment and rehabilitation. The information comes from the Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) Central Luzon said on Saturday, Oct. 10. Edward Sernadilla, head of the Community Environment and Natural Resources Office (CENRO) in nearby Olongapo City, said workers at a company operating at the Subic Bay Freeport found the reptile on their premises. The company personnel secured it to prevent harming the animal and nearby workers. The staff turned over the monitor lizard to their office […]...
